content:
Successful HWPX manipulation requires handling XML node splitting, clearing layout caches, and adhering to specific ZIP packaging standards.
Placeholders like {{placeholder}} are often fragmented across multiple <hp:t> nodes, necessitating a merge-and-replace strategy within the <hp:p> element. Modifying text requires the explicit deletion of <hp:lineSegArray> elements to prevent rendering stale layout data in Hancom Office. The final HWPX must be repacked as a ZIP archive, ideally with the 'mimetype' file as the first uncompressed entry to ensure full compatibility.
